item: Row 409: one leaf lock over every statement on the shared connection (writer generation catch-up, bulk-load seal, registry steps, reference check)
summary: Registry steps and shared-file reads from the segment writer and the bulk load ran on one shared connection without a lock, so two threads could meet inside one transaction. _SHARED_LOCK (leaf: nothing acquired while held) now covers them; a concurrency test fails without it. Writes stay off.
